name: Seated Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
description: A seated overhead barbell extension that isolates the triceps, particularly the long head. Sitting prevents the use of leg drive and momentum, making this an honest isolation movement. Use an EZ bar if the straight bar causes wrist discomfort.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Seated Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Seated Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension.
steps: Step 1: Sit upright on bench with back support. Hold bar overhead with close grip.
Step 2: Keep upper arms vertical and close to head.
Step 3: Lower bar behind head by bending elbows until forearms are past horizontal.
Step 4: Extend elbows to press bar back overhead.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
